openai_user_ban_notification:

If you think this is a mistake, please contact the admin. Your account will be banned in {ban_delay_min} minutes.
chat_removed_from_moderate: Chat {chat_id} is no longer being moderated
audit_log_chat_set: Audit log chat was set to {chat_name} ({chat_id}) by [{user.first_name}](tg://user?id={user.id}) ({user.id})
audit_log_chat_updated: Audit log chat updated from {old_chat_name} ({old_chat_id}) to {new_chat_name} ({new_chat_id}) by [{user.first_name}](tg://user?id={user.id}) ({user.id})
audit_log_chat_removed: Audit log chat has been removed by [{user.first_name}](tg://user?id={user.id}) ({user.id}). Now messages will be logged in the chat where the command was sent
audit_log_chat_not_found: Audit log chat is not set. Are you sure you've configured it?
ban_username_not_found: This username is not in the bot's saved user cache. Use the numeric user ID or reply to the user's message.
ban_username_changed: The username has changed. Use the numeric user ID or reply to the user's message.
mute_usage: Reply to a user message with /mute [duration], or use /mute <user ID|@username> [duration]. Duration defaults to 1d.
unmute_usage: Reply to a user message with /unmute, or use /unmute <user ID|@username>.
mute_invalid_duration: Use a positive integer followed by s/S, m (minutes), h/H, d/D, w/W, M (30 days), y/Y (365 days), or c/C (100 years). Examples: 3h, 451d.
mute_user_not_found: Reply to a user message or provide a positive user ID or @username. An explicit user takes priority over the reply.
mute_supergroup_only: Mute commands are available in supergroups only. The bot needs permission to restrict members.
mute_not_member: The user is not a member of this chat.
mute_failed: Could not mute the user. Error: {error}
unmute_failed: Could not unmute the user. Error: {error}
mute_duration_minimum: 30 seconds (increased to Telegram's minimum mute duration)
audit_log_user_muted: User {user} has been muted for {duration} by {moderator} in chat *{chat}* ({chat_id}). Target: {source}
audit_log_user_unmuted: User {user} has been unmuted by {moderator} in chat *{chat}* ({chat_id}). Target: {source}
unban_usage: Reply to a registered ban audit message with /unban, or use /unban <user ID|@username>.
unban_audit_log_not_found: This message is not registered as a user ban audit entry. Use /unban <user ID|@username>.
unban_username_not_found: This username is not in the bot's saved user cache. Use the numeric user ID or reply to a registered ban audit message.
unban_username_changed: The username has changed. Run /unban again using the numeric user ID.
unban_permission_denied: You must be an administrator of the target chat to unban a user there.
unban_request_not_found: This unban request is unavailable. Send /unban again.
unban_already_processed: This chat has already been processed.
unban_not_banned: The user is not banned in any moderated chat.
unban_choose_chats: The user is still banned in the chats below. Select a chat to unban them.
unban_chat_not_banned: The user is no longer banned in {chat}.

report_usage:
Report commands:
`/report` - Report a message as spam (use in reply to that message)
`/report subscribe` - [Admin] Subscribe to report notifications
`/report unsubscribe` - [Admin] Unsubscribe from report notifications
`/report list` - Show subscribed admins
report_subscribed: You are subscribed to report events
report_unsubscribed: You are unsubscribed from report events
report_already_subscribed: You are already subscribed to report events
report_not_subscribed: You are not subscribed to report events
report_reply_required: Reply to the spam message with /report
report_rate_limit_hour: You can send up to {limit} reports per hour
report_list_empty: No admins are subscribed to report events :/
service_usage:
Service notification commands:
`/as_service subscribe` - [Admin] Subscribe to service notifications
`/as_service unsubscribe` - [Admin] Unsubscribe from service notifications
`/as_service list` - Show subscribers
service_subscribed: You are subscribed to service notifications
service_unsubscribed: You are unsubscribed from service notifications
service_already_subscribed: You are already subscribed to service notifications
service_not_subscribed: You are not subscribed to service notifications
service_list_empty: No admins are subscribed to service notifications :/
coroner_usage: Invalid Coroner command or arguments. Use /help to see available commands.
coroner_group_only: Use Coroner in a private chat with the bot or a moderated group or supergroup.
coroner_ref_group_only: Set the reference with /coroner ref <ID> in a moderated group where the bot can look up this account.
coroner_stopped: Coroner is stopped. Observation continues; checks require /coroner start.
coroner_error_stopped: Coroner is in error. Correct the problem and use /coroner start; stop does not clear the safety lock.
coroner_started: Coroner started in all moderated chats.
coroner_not_running: Checks are disabled. Use /coroner start first.
coroner_ref_saved: Reference account {user_id} saved with chat {chat_id}. Coroner remains stopped; use /coroner start.
coroner_ref_required: Set a live reference account with /coroner ref <ID> before starting.
coroner_start_failed: Coroner could not start. Use /coroner to view recent errors.
coroner_ref_failed: Could not save the reference account. Use /coroner to view recent errors.
coroner_reference_waiting: Waiting for a successful reference check; deletions are blocked.
coroner_removed: Removed users in the last 30 days (unique): {counts}
coroner_storage_error: Cannot read or save the Coroner SQLite database. Checks are stopped; repair the database or permissions and restart the bot.
coroner_config_error: Invalid Coroner configuration. Check coroner_config.json and use /coroner start again.
coroner_api_forbidden: the bot does not have access or the required permissions
coroner_api_invalid_response: Telegram or its API proxy returned an invalid response (not valid JSON); the service may be temporarily unavailable
coroner_api_bad_request: Telegram rejected the request; check the chat, account and bot permissions
coroner_ui_action: Try updating the status again later.
coroner_profile_unknown: The profile for user {user_id} is incomplete or contradictory. No removal was performed; the check will be retried.
coroner_reference_failed: CRITICAL: the reference account {user_id} was detected as deleted. Coroner is in error and requires a successful manual /coroner start.
coroner_reference_unknown: The reference account could not be verified as alive. Deletions are blocked until a successful reference check.
coroner_protected_member: Cannot remove user {user_id}: the account is a chat administrator or owner. No role changes were made.
coroner_uncertain_removal: The result of an interrupted removal of user {user_id} could not be confirmed. It was not counted as a successful removal.
coroner_count_mismatch: The saved participants and Telegram member count disagree. The untracked percentage is unavailable until membership is reconciled.
coroner_worker_error: Coroner encountered an internal error. The affected check will be retried; other bot functions remain available.
coroner_safety_blocked: Automatic removals are blocked. Administrator review is required. {reason}
coroner_safety_kind_activity: A quarantined account sent a new message
coroner_safety_kind_interrupted: A removal has an uncertain result
coroner_safety_kind_budget_history: Insufficient retained history for the configured removal window
coroner_detector_current: Samples: {samples}; matches: {matches}; value: {value}{unit}; threshold: {threshold}{unit}; {progress}% of trigger threshold
coroner_detector_candidates: Currently quarantined: {count}; daily multiplier: {coefficient}; previous complete days, min / max / mean: {history}
coroner_limit_bypass_enabled: Removal percentage limits bypassed. Other safeguards still apply.
coroner_limit_bypass_disabled: Removal percentage limits are enforced again.
coroner_limit_bypass_already_active: Removal-limit bypass is already active; its deadline was not extended.
coroner_limit_bypass_failed: Could not save the removal-limit bypass. Check Coroner errors.
coroner_removed_period: Removals in the last {days} days; percentages use current summed chat memberships:
coroner_review_stale: This action is no longer supported. Showing the current quarantine.
coroner_review_decided: Current anomalies approved until their parameters normalize. New accounts are covered; quarantine and other safeguards still apply.
coroner_profile_buttons_unavailable: Telegram blocks account-link buttons for these IDs in this chat. Other account buttons remain available:
coroner_account_links_loading: Checking account links… You can still use Stop and navigation.
coroner_account_links_failed: Could not finish checking account links. Press Update to retry.
coroner_review_cannot_resume: Cannot release the safety block: quarantine is not empty or a detector is still triggered. Review candidates and resolve the cause first.
coroner_review_resumed: Safety incident acknowledged. Removal budgets were preserved; normal checks and quarantine still apply.
coroner_review_failed: Could not save anomaly approval. Check Coroner errors.
coroner_review_no_anomalies: No new anomalies to approve. Quarantine, reference checks and removal limits still apply.
coroner_review_permissions: Approved anomalies: {count}; each permission resets when its parameter normalizes.
help_legend: 🔒 Administrators only. <parameter> required; [parameter] optional. Shortcuts appear in parentheses.
help_menu_moderate: Enable moderation or list moderated chats (/moderate ls).
help_menu_report: Report spam and manage report subscriptions.
moderate_usage: Use /moderate to enable moderation in this chat, or /moderate ls to list moderated chats.
help_set_audit_log: Use this chat as the audit log.
help_unset_audit_log: Remove the configured audit log chat.
help_ban_reply: Reply to a message to ban its author and delete it.
help_ban_id: Ban a user by numeric ID in this chat.
help_ban_username: Ban a user by username from the saved user cache.
help_banc_reply: Reply to a forwarded message to block its source channel.
help_banc_id: Block a source channel by ID in all moderated chats.
help_unban_reply: Reply to a registered ban audit entry to unban the user.
help_unban_id: Find bans by user ID and choose chats to unban them.
help_unban_username: Find bans by cached username and choose chats to unban them.
help_mute_reply: Reply to a user message to mute its author; duration defaults to 1d.
help_mute_user: Mute a user in this chat; duration defaults to 1d. An explicit ID or cached username overrides the reply.
help_unmute_reply: Reply to a user message to lift the author's mute in this chat.
help_unmute_user: Unmute a user in this chat; an explicit ID or cached username overrides the reply.
help_report: Reply to a spam message to notify subscribed administrators.
help_as_service_list: List subscribers to service incident notifications.
help_coroner_status: Show global statistics and recent errors.
help_coroner_ref: Save a live reference account from a moderated group.
help_coroner_start: Verify the reference account and start checks across moderated chats.
help_coroner_run: Queue checks for a grade; Coroner must be running.
help_coroner_detectors: Show anomaly detector statistics and thresholds.
help_coroner_quarantine: Show quarantined accounts and profile links.
help_coroner_bypass: Temporarily bypass removal percentage limits for the configured duration.
help_coroner_bypass_stop: Cancel the removal percentage limit bypass.
